claims.statement: Commands.pendingGates() carries the step: role (entry|exit), leg, the contract intent, since, and delivered = {commits, claims, unclaimed, checks, bound} — the same conclusion() the close enforces, derived on demand; unit-tested incl. entry vs exit and per-row counts

GET /api/gates serves that value unchanged (the service is still a thin binding); the service e2e reads the enriched rows (role/leg/intent) and asserts the per-row delivered counts, incl. T1's full conclusion vs T2/T3's zeros

each queue row names the step: an ENTRY/EXIT badge + the gate + what approving does + the task intent as the title + id/leg/waiting-since + the delivered summary (or nothing delivered yet); the card header names the same step — asserted by the e2e page test on the served script

the card renders the node data (intent · ACs · workType/model · resolved inputs · open questions), CLAIMS with their resolved pointers (NO CLAIM RECORDED for gaps), CHECKS, gate states and results — the fields /api/confirm already carried
